label: TiO2Pnma
note: Hypothetical Pnma-type TiO2 polymorph, never synthesized -- added from Reitz & Dronskowski (Inorg. Chem. 2026, revised/reviewer-added case, Figure 8/eq. 9): manuscript reports r2SCAN E_above_hull=10.42 kJ/mol, DeltaE(r2SCAN, vs rutile)=-8 kJ/mol, DeltaICOHP=-9 kJ/mol, exobondic. History: first computed under this project's plain-PBE extension_ pipeline settings (a metadata note here previously and WRONGLY claimed 'PBEsol/D3' -- the pipeline actually runs plain PBE, no dispersion correction, confirmed via OUTCAR; DeltaICOHP(Pnma->rutile) that way = -10.05 kJ/mol -- see git history), then re-relaxed (ISIF=3, IBRION=2, SYMPREC=1e-4 on rutile) and recomputed with METAGGA=R2scan (ENCUT=700) to match the manuscript's actual functional. r2SCAN result: relaxed a=18.7655/b=4.6826/c=2.9653 A (SI Table S1: a=18.76727/b(SI c)=4.68009/c(SI b)=2.96575 A, axes permuted vs. our setting, ~0.02-0.05% agreement); DeltaICOHP(Pnma->rutile)=-9.48 kJ/mol (manuscript: -9 kJ/mol) and DeltaE=-7.70 kJ/mol (manuscript r2SCAN: -8 kJ/mol, MP: -10 kJ/mol) -- both essentially exact matches. See extension_TiO2rutile_mp-2657 (the matching decomposition-product reference, same r2SCAN settings) and analysis/REPORT_cao_polymorph_verification.md for full method and the parallel CaO verification.
